title: Feature request: book a library study room from the app
text:
## Background

In both rounds of Westbrook beta feedback, the number one request was a way to **book a library study room** right from Pairly once a group is formed.

## Ideas

- Ask the Westbrook library staff if their room booking system has an API (Tomas Rivera will ask)
- For the website: add a "Coming soon: book a study room" section to show students we heard them
- For the app (after launch): show free rooms that match the group's session time

Not planned for the Nov 2 launch. To discuss at the weekly sync with Maya Chen.
